intro.fr: A Little to the Left se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: A Little to the Left can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Max Inferno sort A Little to the Left en 2022.
text.en: Max Inferno releases A Little to the Left in 2022.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub drohack/alttl-archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de A Little to the Left.
text.en: The GitHub repository drohack/alttl-archipelago, home of the A Little to the Left APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.3.0.
text.en: The first version, v0.3.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.0.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (13 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v1.0.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (13 versions released).

text.fr: A Little to the Left figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: A Little to the Left is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
